goal: AgriLearn AI is an agricultural smart application that uses artificial intelligence to scan crops, interpret weather and environmental data, provide rapid educational diagnostics, deliver early warnings, and offer localized farming guidance that helps farmers prevent losses, use water and farm inputs more efficiently, and improve productivity.

modules.title: Weather & Prevention
modules.summary: Localized rain, heat, frost and drought intelligence.

modules.title: Early Alerts
modules.summary: Regional pest, disease and fungal-risk notifications.

modules.title: Pest & Disease Detection
modules.summary: Photo-based learning support for visible crop symptoms.

modules.title: Nutrient & Soil Insights
modules.summary: Educational assessment of discoloration and soil patterns.
capabilities: Possible nitrogen, iron and other deficiencies

modules.title: Farmer Advisory
modules.summary: Location, crop and season-aware farm planning.

modules.title: Yield Optimization
modules.summary: Decision support for water, inputs and productivity.
